name: tamalou
description: Tamalou, the French card game, playable on the web: solo against bots, pass-and-play, LAN and online.
author: Steeve Pommier

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/src/sw && tsc --noEmit -p apps/worker
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.worker:dev: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @tamalou/worker exec wrangler dev
scripts.worker:deploy: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @tamalou/worker exec wrangler deploy
